members.name: PostPropagate

members.doc: Triggered just before the next propagation step is attempted. Use the input interface to access force model settings. Returning false will turn this callback off.

members.name: Evaluate

members.name: PostEvaluate

AgStkGraphicsRasterImageGlobeOverlayFact.doc: A globe image overlay for handling rasters.

This is used to show an object in some scenes and hide it in others.

members.name: GPS_Pos_Array

members.name: AntennaDir_Array

AgCrdnInstance.doc: Enables to obtain information about the parent object that owns the VGT component.

AgCrdnTemplate.doc: Enables to obtain information about the STK class that owns the VGT component.

AgCrdnPointRefTo.doc: Represents a reference to a VGT point.

AgCrdnAxesRefTo.doc: Represents a reference to a VGT axes.

AgCrdnAngleRefTo.doc: Represents a reference to a VGT angle.

AgCrdnAxesLabels.doc: Allows configuring the VGT axes labels.

AgCrdnPlaneLabels.doc: Allows configuring the X and Y axes labels.

AgCrdnAxesAlignedAndConstrained.doc: Axes aligned using two pairs of vectors. One vector in each pair is fixed in these axes and the other vector serves as an independent reference.

AgCrdnAxesAngularOffset.doc: Axes created by rotating the Reference axes about the Spin vector through the specified rotation angle plus the additional rotational offset.

AgCrdnAxesFixedAtEpoch.doc: Axes based on another set fixed at a specified epoch.

AgCrdnAxesBPlane.doc: B-Plane axes using the selected target body and reference vector.

AgCrdnAxesCustomScript.doc: Customized axes offset with respect to a set of reference Axes.

AgCrdnAxesAttitudeFile.doc: Axes specified by data from a file.

AgCrdnAxesModelAttach.doc: Axes aligned with the specified pointable element of the object's 3D model. The axes follow the model as well as any articulations that affect the specified pointable element.

AgCrdnAxesSpinning.doc: Axes created by spinning the Reference axes about the Spin vector with the specified rate. The axes are aligned with the Reference axes at the specified epoch plus the additional rotational offset.

AgCrdnAxesOnSurface.doc: Topocentric axes located at the reference point's projection on the central body.

AgCrdnAxesTrajectory.doc: Axes based on trajectory of the point relative to the reference coordinate system.

AgCrdnAxesLagrangeLibration.doc: Libration point axes using one primary and multiple secondary central bodies. Set primary and secondary bodies, and point type.

AgCrdnAxesCommonTasks.doc: Provides methods to create non-persistent VGT axes components. Non-persistent components do not have names, do not get saved/loaded and are not shown in the VGT browser.

AgCrdnAxesAtTimeInstant.doc: Axes orientation fixed relative to reference axes based on orientation of another set of axes evaluated at specified time instant.

AgCrdnAngleDihedral.doc: An angle between two vectors about an axis.

AgCrdnAngleRotation.doc: Angle of the shortest rotation between the specified FromAxes and ToAxes axes.

AgCrdnAngleToPlane.doc: An angle between a vector and a plane.

AgCrdnPlaneNormal.doc: A plane normal to a vector at a given point.

AgCrdnPlaneQuadrant.doc: A plane based on a selected Quadrant of a reference system.

AgCrdnPlaneTrajectory.doc: The plane is defined on the basis of a trajectory of a Point with respect to a ReferenceSystem.

AgCrdnPlaneTriad.doc: A Plane containing points PointA, PointB and ReferencePont with the first axis aligned with the direction from the ReferencePoint to PointA and the second axis toward the direction from the ReferencePoint to PointB.

AgCrdnPointBPlane.doc: B-Plane point using the selected target body.

AgCrdnPointFile.doc: Point specified by data from a file.

AgCrdnPointFixedInSystem.doc: Point fixed in a reference coordinate system using the selected coordinate type.

AgCrdnPointGrazing.doc: The grazing point is the point of closest approach to the surface of the selected central body along a defined direction.

AgCrdnPointGlint.doc: Point on central body surface that reflects from source to observer.

AgCrdnPointCovarianceGrazing.doc: The point of closest approach to the surface of the specified position covariance ellipsoid surface along a defined direction. Position covariance must be available for a vehicle object to be considered a possible target for this option.

AgCrdnPointPlaneIntersection.doc: Point on a plane located along a given direction looking from a given origin.

AgCrdnPointOnSurface.doc: The detic subpoint of the reference point as projected onto the central body.

AgCrdnPointModelAttach.doc: A point placed at the specified attachment point of the object's 3D model. The point follows the model as well as any articulations that affect the specified attachment point.

AgCrdnPointPlaneProjection.doc: The projection of a point onto a reference plane. Specify the Source Point and Reference Plane.

AgCrdnPointLagrangeLibration.doc: Libration point using one primary and multiple secondary central bodies. Set the central body, secondary central bodies, and point type.

AgCrdnVectorFixedAtEpoch.doc: Based on another vector fixed at a specified epoch.

AgCrdnVectorAngularVelocity.doc: Angular velocity vector of one set of axes computed with respect to the reference set.

AgCrdnVectorConing.doc: Vector created by revolving the Reference vector around the About vector with the specified rate.

AgCrdnVectorCross.doc: The vector cross product of two vectors.

AgCrdnVectorCustomScript.doc: Customized vector components defined with respect to reference axes.

AgCrdnVectorDerivative.doc: A vector derivative of a vector computed with respect to specified axes.

AgCrdnVectorDisplacement.doc: Vector defined by its start and end points.

AgCrdnVectorTwoPlanesIntersection.doc: Defined along the intersection of two planes.

AgCrdnVectorPeriapsis.doc: Vector from the center of the specified central body to the nearest point of an elliptical orbit created from the motion of the specified point.

IAgGatorPluginEngineModel.doc: Astrogator plugin engine model interface whose methods are called at certain events in the propagation process. A method returning false indicates an error.

members.name: Name
members.doc: Triggered to set the name of the plugin used in messages.

members.name: Init
members.doc: Triggered when the plugin is initialized to allow for any additional needed initialization. Must return true to turn on use of plugin.

members.name: PrePropagate
members.doc: Triggered just before propagation starts. Use the input interface to access engine model settings.

members.name: PreNextStep
members.doc: Triggered just before the next propagation step is attempted. Use the input interface to access engine model settings. Returning false will turn this callback off.

members.name: Evaluate
members.doc: Triggered on every force model evaluation during the propagation of a step. Use the input interface to access engine model settings. Returning false will turn this callback off.

members.name: Free
members.doc: Triggered just before the plugin is freed from use to allow for any additional cleanup.

members.name: Evaluate
members.doc: Triggered on every force model evaluation during the propagation of a step. Use the input interface to access attitude controller settings. Returning false will turn this callback off.

members.name: Free
members.doc: Triggered just before the plugin is freed from use to allow for any additional cleanup.

members.name: DayCount

members.name: PosVel
members.doc: Current position and velocity in the requested frame.

members.name: PosVel_Array

members.name: LatLonAlt
members.doc: Current detic latitude, detic longitude, and altitude.

members.name: LatLonAlt_Array
members.doc: Current detic latitude, detic longitude, and altitude(in internal units) returned as an array representing lat, lon, alt. Useful for scripting clients.

members.name: SunPosition
members.doc: Position of the sun wrt the current satellite position, in the requested frame, computed in the requested manner.

members.name: SunPosition_Array
members.doc: Position of the sun wrt the current satellite position, in the requested frame, computed in the requested manner, (in internal units) returned as an array representing x, y, z. Useful for scripting clients.

members.name: TransformVector
members.doc: Transforms a vector from the input frame to the output frame.

members.name: TransformVector_Array
members.doc: Transforms a vector from the input frame to the output frame (in internal units) returned as an array representing x, y, z. Useful for scripting clients.

members.name: RefAxes

members.name: SetRefAxes

members.name: SetQuaternion
members.doc: Sets the current orientation using a quaternion.

members.name: EulerRotate
members.doc: Sets the current orientation using a sequence of euler rotations.

members.name: GetQuaternion
members.doc: Gets the current orientation as a quaternion.

members.name: GetQuaternion_Array
members.doc: Gets the current orientation as a quaternion returned as an array representing Q1, Q2, Q3, and Q4. Useful for scripting clients.

members.name: GetEulerRotation
members.doc: Gets the current orientation as euler angles.

members.name: GetEulerRotation_Array
members.doc: Gets the current orientation as euler rotations returned as an array. Useful for scripting clients.

members.name: StopPropagation
members.doc: Stops propagation.  For fatal errors.

members.name: DateElements
members.doc: Current epoch in requested time scale expressed in date format. Year [yyyy], DayOfYear [1-366], Month [1-12], DayOfMonth [1-31], Hour [0-23], Minute [0-59], Seconds [0-60].

members.name: DateElements_Array
members.doc: Current epoch in requested time scale expressed in date format returned as the array: Year [yyyy], DayOfYear [1-366], Month [1-12], DayOfMonth [1-31], Hour [0-23], Minute [0-59], Seconds [0-60]. Useful for scripting clients.
